$comment: Decision 0032: which end-to-end groups a pull request's changed path needs. A path takes the union of the groups of every rule it matches; a path no rule matches runs every group, never none. "groups": "spec" means the group that runs that spec file (or 'rest'). "groups": [] means the path cannot change what an end-to-end test sees. The full run on main and the nightly run every group whatever this file says. Patterns: * is any run of characters but /, ** any run including /. Every rule is checked by tools/ci/test/select.test.ts against the repository.

rules.why: Documentation, the control register, the requirements and the decisions: no screen, server or database reads them (compliance/rule-tables and compliance/validation are read by the server, so they are not here and run every group).
Unit and database tests and their fixtures: the end-to-end stack does not load them.
Tools the end-to-end stack does not import (tools/e2e imports @ebmr/demo, api-contract, kernel, recipe-core and test-kit only).
A spec file runs in its own group.

The injectables edition: its database namespace, its apps and its library blocks are exercised by the injectables groups; gmp-batches is the tablets canary for edition SQL that the shared database also loads.
Capsule library blocks: the two capsule groups.
